course_name_original: Electric Power Stations and Substations Engineering – Course Project
course_name_en: Electric Power Stations and Substations Engineering – Course Project

learning_outcomes.text: Improve student's knowledge in designing electrical part of distribution power system 110/6-20 kV.

syllabus_topics: Electrical research involving choice of the primary (major scheme) of the power station
Calculating the current during normal regimes and short circuit in the distribution systems high and middle voltage
Choice of exploitation regime for work of the star centre for the networks high and middle voltage
Choice of commutation apparatuses (circuit-breakers and disconnectors)
Choice of current and voltage measuring transformers
Choice of flexible and hard connectors for electric circuit for high and middle voltage
Choice of fuse for protection of the circuits "own needs" and "measurement"
Choice of serge arresters for protection from overload
Full single-line diagram of the substation
Sections of MV cells of conventional MV switchgear or facades of complete switchgear
Unfolded diagrams for control, measurements and interlock
assessment_rules: The final examination mark is complex and depends on the design and the defense of the course work. The course work is handed over at the end of the term. Assessment is an oral defense.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Electrical Power Engineering (Bachelor)
